summary: Round 3 UI testing completed successfully. Verified all 5 major UI changes: (1) Hero rotating word is now solid black with shine effect (no gradient), (2) Skip Intro button correctly jumps to Services section, (3) Services cards display full content (image + description + bullets) without side-sheet, (4) Solutions carousel reverted to WHITE background with dark text, (5) Gallery renamed to 'Through My Eyes' with autoplay carousel (3s interval), no scrollbar, and prev/next arrows. All regression tests passed. Tested on both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports.
